title: Machine and Gravity
author: Beatrix Sandoval
blurb: Rafael Hartwell, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
